description: Read and search The Urantia Book through the free Urantia Papers API from urantia.dev. Look up any of its 14,500 paragraphs by reference, pull a random one for a daily quote, read a whole paper, search by words or by meaning, explore its index of named beings, places and concepts, check a quotation, format a citation, and compare passages with the Bible and nine texts of the world's religions.
